e7_s4_rejected.label: Pancreatic metastasis from bladder cancer
e7_s4_rejected.why: While the patient has a history of bladder cancer, the presence of a primary mass in the pancreas and the specific imaging and laboratory findings point more towards a primary pancreatic malignancy rather than a metastasis.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Chronic pancreatitis with pseudocyst
e7_s4_rejected.why: The acute presentation and the specific findings of a mass in the portal vein and multiple cystic lesions within the pancreatic head are not typical for chronic pancreatitis with pseudocyst.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Autoimmune pancreatitis
e7_s4_rejected.why: The extensive autoimmune and infectious work-up was negative, and the presence of a distinct mass and cystic lesions in the pancreas does not align with the typical presentation of autoimmune pancreatitis.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Pancreatic acinar cell carcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: While this is a possible diagnosis, the combination of the patient's clinical presentation, laboratory findings, and imaging results more strongly supports pancreatic adenocarcinoma, which is more common and has a broader range of presentations that can include the findings described.
